title: What No First Stage Can Detect: Functional-Form Contamination in Linear IV
abstract: arXiv:2609.18172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Applied instrumental variables (IV) practice reports a first-stage F, now often the conditional F of Sanderson and Windmeijer (2016), and reads a large value as license to interpret the second stage. We show that no first-stage diagnostic can provide it. With a scalar instrument, a scalar treatment, and covariates entered linearly, the 2SLS estimand splits into a signal that a saturated specification would target and a contamination, the covariance between curvature in the instrument propensity and a covariate level function. The same nuisance sits in both terms, so it biases the estimand and inflates the reported strength at once. When the instrument is nearly collinear with the covariates the signal vanishes and the strength is manufactured. translated_title: 任何第一阶段都无法检测到的问题：线性工具变量法中的函数形式污染
translated_abstract: 应用工具变量（IV）的实践中通常会报告第一阶段F统计量——如今常用Sanderson和Windmeijer（2016）提出的条件F统计量——并将较大的数值解读为可以解释第二阶段结果的许可。我们证明没有任何第一阶段诊断统计量能够提供这种许可。在标量工具变量、标量处理变量以及协变量以线性形式进入模型的设定下，2SLS估计对象可分解为两部分：一部分是饱和设定所针对的信号成分，另一部分是污染成分——即工具变量倾向性中的曲率与协变量水平函数之间的协方差。同一个干扰项同时存在于这两部分之中，因此它既使估计对象产生偏误，又同时夸大了所报告的工具变量强度。当工具变量与协变量近似共线时，信号消失而强度是被人为制造出来的。当强度真实存在时，曲率仍会通过结果方程使估计对象产生偏误，而任何第一阶段数字都无法触及这一偏误。我们证明，不存在工具变量联合分布的任何泛函……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明任何第一阶段诊断统计量（如F统计量）都无法检测线性工具变量法中的函数形式污染——工具变量倾向性曲率与协变量之间的协方差既会使2SLS估计对象产生偏误，又会同时夸大所报告的工具变量强度，因此第一阶段强度检验不能成为解释第二阶段结果的依据。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that no first-stage diagnostic (such as the F-statistic) can detect functional-form contamination in linear IV: the covariance between instrument propensity curvature and covariate level functions simultaneously biases the 2SLS estimand and inflates reported instrument strength, so first-stage strength tests cannot license second-stage interpretation.
